rules.statement: Don't ask a render-comparison check to add answer combinations for template exclude conditions that the pull request leaves unchanged; ask only for coverage of the conditions the change moves or edits.
rules.why: The maintainer declined this: conditions identical to the base branch can't be broken by the change, so the comparison needs no new cases for them.
rules.check: Before reporting missing answer sets, diff the template's exclude/conditional entries against the base branch. Report only if an entry the PR edited or moved has no answer set that exercises it.

rules.statement: Don't ask CI to run a check that asserts renders are byte-identical to a base ref; it's a manual tool for refactors that must change nothing.
rules.why: Run in CI against the latest release, it would fail on every pull request that changes what generated projects get on purpose, which is most of them.
rules.check: If a render-identity script is documented as a manual tool (in its help or the README) and named so the test runner skips it, don't report that CI doesn't run it.
